name: EPIC 245937587
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 10.9 solar radii and 1.51 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,405 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.51 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,123 K at its surface.
